citations.title: Ramen Profitable
citations.author: Paul Graham
citations.note: July 2009. Covering the founders' living expenses from revenue changes the fundraising power balance and removes the ticking clock.

citations.title: How Not to Die
citations.author: Paul Graham
citations.note: August 2007. Startups rarely die in mid-keystroke — they die because the founders give up or run out of money while demoralized.

citations.title: Relentlessly Resourceful
citations.author: Paul Graham
citations.note: March 2009. The two-word test for good founders: relentlessly resourceful — the opposite of hapless.

citations.title: Be Good
citations.author: Paul Graham
citations.note: April 2008. Benevolence as strategy: being genuinely good to users compounds into growth, morale, and help from outside.

citations.title: YC Startup Library
citations.author: Y Combinator
citations.note: YC's open library of essays and videos across the whole lifecycle — the largest free curated corpus of partner-written startup advice.

citations.title: The YC SAFE — overview, generator and calculator
citations.author: Y Combinator
citations.note: YC's explainer for the post-money SAFE, with a document generator and a dilution calculator.

citations.title: YC Series A Term Sheet Template
citations.author: Y Combinator
citations.note: YC's annotated standard Series A term sheet — a clean baseline for what a fair priced-round term sheet looks like.

citations.title: First Round Review
citations.author: First Round Capital
citations.note: Long-form operator interviews and playbooks; the strongest open corpus on management and company building between seed and scale.

citations.title: The Struggle
citations.author: Ben Horowitz (Andreessen Horowitz)
citations.note: 2012. The definitive essay on the psychological low points of running a company — the Struggle is where greatness comes from, and everyone goes through it.

citations.title: Steve Blank — customer development corpus
citations.author: Steve Blank
citations.note: Origin of customer development and 'get out of the building' — the empirical method underneath the lean-startup movement.

citations.title: Stripe Atlas Guides
citations.author: Stripe
citations.note: Open guides on incorporation mechanics, equity, taxes, and early SaaS operations, written for first-time founders.

citations.title: Rewarding Talent — the Index Ventures option-plan handbook
citations.author: Index Ventures
citations.note: Published benchmarks and conventions for employee option pools and grant sizing, US and Europe. Cited by lib/openstartup/equityComp.ts.

citations.title: IRS Form 15620 — Section 83(b) Election
citations.author: Internal Revenue Service
citations.note: The official 83(b) election form and instructions, including the 30-day filing window. Also recorded as the authority citation irs-form-15620-2025 for the law rules.

citations.title: IRS — Apply for an Employer Identification Number (EIN) online
citations.author: Internal Revenue Service
citations.note: The official (free) EIN application — the step paid intermediaries most often resell to founders.

citations.title: Delaware Code, Title 8, Chapter 5 — Corporation Franchise Tax
citations.author: Delaware General Assembly (Delaware Code Online)
citations.note: The statute behind the March 1 annual report and franchise tax obligation (8 Del. C. §§ 502-504).

citations.title: Delaware Division of Corporations — Annual Report and Franchise Tax
citations.author: Delaware Division of Corporations
citations.note: Official filing instructions and due dates; the default authorized-shares bill is often recomputable far lower under the assumed-par-value-capital method.

citations.title: Delaware Division of Corporations — How to Form a New Business Entity
citations.author: Delaware Division of Corporations
citations.note: Official formation instructions and links to the state's own certificate forms and fee schedules.

citations.title: USPTO — Trademark basics
citations.author: United States Patent and Trademark Office
citations.note: The official primer on what trademarks protect, searching, and filing — before paying a clearance service.

citations.title: USPTO — Patent basics
citations.author: United States Patent and Trademark Office
citations.note: The official primer on patent types, timelines, and provisional applications.

citations.title: U.S. Copyright Office — Registration portal
citations.author: U.S. Copyright Office
citations.note: Official registration process and fees for software and content copyright.

citations.title: Cooley GO document generators and forms
citations.author: Cooley LLP
citations.note: Free generators for incorporation packages, Series Seed financings, offer letters, CIIAAs, NDAs, and advisor agreements. Per-document records live in open-documents/registry.json.

citations.title: NVCA Model Legal Documents
citations.author: National Venture Capital Association
citations.note: The industry-standard priced-round document suite (stock purchase agreement, charter, investors' rights, voting, ROFR, term sheet) that most US venture financings start from.

citations.title: Common Paper standard agreements
citations.author: Common Paper
citations.note: Openly licensed commercial contract standards (Cloud Service Agreement, Mutual NDA, DPA, and more) with committee-maintained terms.

citations.title: Bonterms standard forms download center
citations.author: Bonterms
citations.note: Committee-drafted open standard agreements (Cloud Terms, Mutual NDA, DPA, AI Addendum) downloadable from a single page.

citations.title: oneNDA — the open standard NDA
citations.author: oneNDA (Claustack)
citations.note: A single standardized mutual NDA adopted by thousands of companies; the point of the standard is to not negotiate it.

citations.title: The SAFT Project
citations.author: Cooley LLP and Protocol Labs
citations.note: The Simple Agreement for Future Tokens whitepaper and form. Securities-law treatment is contested; counsel is mandatory, not optional.
